video.title: AI欧腐《暗影骑士与光之王子/His Shadow, My Light》
video.desc:
Once an elite prodigy, Giovanni feigned ruin as a rake to avenge his mother—while secretly protecting Prince Alaric as the Shadow Knight. When war struck, he unleashed his true power, crushed the enemy, and claimed the Prince in marriage! Framed for treason, Giovanni was doomed to die. To save him, Alaric surrendered his crown in a dangerous alliance. Breaking his seal in a lethal rage, Giovanni crashed the royal wedding—bloody, unhinged, and ready to reclaim his Prince!
Giovanni曾是万众瞩目的天才，却为了替母亲复仇，故意伪装成放浪形骸的纨绔子弟；与此同时，他还以暗影骑士 的身份，暗中守护着王子Alaric。
战火燃起时，Giovanni终于释放真正的力量，一举击溃敌军，并迎娶了Alaric王子。
可后来，他被人陷害叛国，命悬一线。为了救他，Alaric不惜交出王冠，与危险势力结盟。
当Giovanni在致命怒火中冲破封印，他浑身浴血、近乎失控地闯入王室婚礼——只为夺回属于他的王子。
